translations.Missing-entry reminders: checked daily;: Missing-entry reminders: checked daily; employee and HR delivery can be enabled separately. Successful reminders are at least seven days apart.
translations.Employee balance emails: sent on Mondays: Employee balance emails: sent on Mondays when the configured overtime or negative-hours threshold is exceeded.
translations.Personal HR emails are configured in the: Personal HR emails are configured in the HR overview and sent on Mondays. The group reminder switches do not control these emails.
translations.Freelancers and inactive employees recei: Freelancers and inactive employees receive no warning emails.
translations.HR groups contain responsible HR account: HR groups contain responsible HR accounts. Employee groups contain the employees they manage.
translations.The rule with the lowest priority number: The rule with the lowest priority number applies. Equal priorities keep the first saved rule.
translations.For questions about the working time bal: For questions about the working time balance or recorded entries, contact the responsible HR team.
translations.Reminder for missing or incomplete time: Reminder for missing or incomplete time entries
translations.Employees receive their own outstanding: Employees receive their own outstanding dates. HR receives a summary for assigned employees. Checks run daily after the configured waiting period. Further reminders are sent no sooner than seven days later.
translations.Settings → Timesheet → Group rule → “Mis: Settings → Timesheet → Group rule → “Missing time entry reminders”. Employee and HR delivery can be enabled separately.
translations.Overtime and negative-hours email to emp: Overtime and negative-hours email to employees
translations.Employees receive an email on Mondays if: Employees receive an email on Mondays if their own working time balance exceeds the configured threshold. The email directs questions to HR.
translations.In the same group rule under “Employee b: In the same group rule under “Employee balance notifications”. Overtime and negative hours can be configured separately.
translations.HR receives a combined email on Mondays: HR receives a combined email on Mondays about excessive overtime, excessive negative hours or a long period without a new entry.
translations.HR overview → “My HR email settings”. Th: HR overview → “My HR email settings”. These settings apply only to the signed-in HR account.
translations.The “Email recipients” selection in the: The “Email recipients” selection in the group rule determines which HR accounts receive emails.
translations.These settings apply only to the signed-: These settings apply only to the signed-in HR account.

translations.In the selected group rule under “Employ: In the selected group rule under “Employee balance notifications”. Overtime and negative hours can be configured separately.
translations.HR overview → Notifications → “My HR ema: HR overview → Notifications → “My HR emails”. These settings apply only to the signed-in HR account.
translations.Time rules are managed under Profile → S: Time rules are managed under Profile → Settings → Timesheet. Email settings are available below under Notifications. Administrators manage HR and employee assignments.

translations.Checks run daily. Open dates are collect: Checks run daily. Open dates are collected in one email, with at least seven days between emails of the same kind.

translations.Days that require a time entry; public h: Days that require a time entry; public holidays in the employee state are excluded.
translations.Each HR account sets its own thresholds: Each HR account sets its own thresholds for alerts about the employees it is responsible for. The same threshold applies to each alert in the employee list and the weekly email to HR.
translations.Employee list and weekly email to HR: Employee list and weekly email to HR
translations.Employees can also get an email about th: Employees can also get an email about their own time balance on Mondays if the group rule enables it and their balance exceeds the threshold.
translations.Enter whole days or hours and minutes in: Enter whole days or hours and minutes in the format HH:MM.
translations.Existing members use the chosen start da: Existing members use the chosen start date. Later members are checked from their first detection. A state is required for the holiday check.
translations.The employee list shows the current aler: The employee list shows the current alerts in the app. The weekly email to HR bundles the selected alerts that still apply on Monday.
translations.The new rule works as in this example. E: The new rule works as in this example. Employee A records no working time for Tuesday. On Wednesday, employee B only records that he started at 8 a.m. With a two-calendar-day waiting period, employee A receives an email notification on Thursday and employee B on Friday.
translations.The reminder shows which workdays still: The reminder shows which workdays still need an entry or a correction. The group rule lets you change which HR account receives the notification email.
translations.This alert highlights long gaps in time: This alert highlights long gaps in time tracking. At a threshold of 14 days, HR can see who has gone at least 14 days without a complete time entry.
translations.This alert shows when an employee last m: This alert shows when an employee last made an entry in the timesheet. The threshold in calendar days determines when HR is notified.
translations.When checked, this alert is also include: When checked, this alert is also included in the weekly summary email.
translations.With a threshold of 10 hours, HR can see: With a threshold of 10 hours, HR can see in the employee list who has 10 or more hours of overtime.
With a threshold of 10 hours, HR can see in the employee list who has a time deficit of 10 hours or more.
